accepted_answers.name: datetime.fromisoformat + dateutil.parser
accepted_answers.why: fromisoformat (extended in 3.11+) covers ISO-8601; dateutil.parser.parse covers arbitrary human formats with fuzzy parsing and tz handling.

accepted_answers.name: dateutil.parser.isoparse
accepted_answers.why: Accepted strict ISO-8601 alternative with fuller spec coverage than fromisoformat on older versions.

notes: Strong consensus. Hand-rolled strptime format guessing and regex date parsing miss edge cases (timezones, ambiguous day/month, ISO weeks).
problem: Parsing date/time strings in Python with hand-written format guessing or regex.
